input.name: Lumen Telecom
input.businessDescription: Lumen Telecom is a fictional mid-size telecom operator serving consumers and small businesses across a national footprint. It sells home broadband (fiber and fixed wireless), postpaid and prepaid mobile plans, phones and accessories, TV and streaming bundles, a smart home security add-on, and connectivity plans for small and medium businesses. Customers manage everything in the Lumen app, online account, or in one of 120 stores. Support is available by chat, phone, and email. Lumen is headquartered in Riverside and operates a national network with 5G coverage in most cities.
input.pricing: Home fiber 500: $55/month. Home fiber 1 Gbps: $70/month. Fixed wireless 100 Mbps: $45/month. Postpaid Basic: $35/month with 10 GB data. Postpaid Plus: $60/month with 50 GB data and 15 GB hotspot. Postpaid Unlimited: $85/month with unlimited data, 50 GB hotspot. Second line on any postpaid plan: 50% off the monthly price. Prepaid Starter: $20 for 30 days with 8 GB. Prepaid Max: $40 for 30 days with unlimited data after 40 GB. Roaming Day Pass: $10 per day in 60+ countries. International calling bundle: $5/month for 200 minutes to 40 countries. TV Essentials: $30/month. TV Plus: $55/month with premium channels. Streaming add-on bundle: $12/month for three streaming apps. Home security starter kit: $199 one-time plus $15/month monitoring. Business Connect: from $89/month per site, with static IP available for $10/month. Late payment fee: $8 after a 7-day grace period. Device financing is interest-free over 24 months with approved credit. Trade-in credit depends on model and condition. Early termination fee on 24-month contracts: $25 per remaining month, capped at $300.
input.faqs: Q: How do I check my data usage? A: Open the Lumen app, select Usage. Q: Can I change my plan mid-cycle? A: Yes, changes take effect at the next billing date unless you upgrade, which starts today. Q: Where is my bill due? A: The due date is shown on your bill and in the app; autopay is available. Q: How do I report an outage? A: Check the outage map in the app first, then report it from Support if the outage does not show. Q: Do you offer installation? A: Yes, fiber installation is booked online and usually takes 1 to 2 weeks. Q: Support hours? A: Chat is 24/7 for account questions; phone support is 7am to 11pm local time every day. Q: Is my data safe? A: We encrypt account data, and you can request a copy or deletion of your personal data from the privacy page.
input.goals: Answer customer questions accurately about plans, billing, network, devices, and account management. Send customers to the right place (app, store, or team) when the bot cannot act. Collect contact details only when a team member needs to follow up.
input.dataToCollect: Name and best contact email or phone for team follow-ups.
